errors.what: full pages suite: 2 build tests failed (pf-chrome.css must hold no hard-coded colour / no opacity) once the voice CSS moved there
errors.fix: exempted ASSISTANT_VOICE_CSS the way VENTURE_CHROME_CSS already is, with the reason in the test; re-ran those tests, 5/5 pass

doc_friction.issue: Listed 'Lighthouse attributes 35 ms of forced reflow' to the launcher's <style> append as a lever. An isolated A/B timed the difference at about 1.7 ms (4x throttle); the attribution was the first full style pass, which happens anyway. Polish notes should time a change in isolation before naming it as a saving.
Comment said 'pf-chrome.css stays colour-free', but VENTURE_CHROME_CSS already puts a palette in that file; the build tests carry the real rule and its exemptions.
Running the full pages test suite alongside Playwright timing runs skewed the timings (an 'after' build looked 18% slower). Worth a line: don't time pages while the suite runs.

deviations.result: 2,238 of 2,238 identical; no visual change, as intended

notes: Built the site twice (before and after the change). node platform/pages/check.mjs: publishable, 8,360 pages, no dead links. node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1512/1515 pass (2 failures were the colour/opacity tests, fixed after the run; 1 skipped). certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
